subject: Certificate rotation & SAN validation — pre-cutover priming and post-cutover smoke plan
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ellis Trujillo <ellis.trujillo@acmecloud.com>, ACME Cloud Ops <ops@acmecloud.com>, DataCenter NOC <noc@dc.example.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Certificate rotation & SAN validation — pre-cutover priming and post-cutover smoke plan

Hi all,

As we get closer to the private deploy cutover window (Oct 2nd, 02:00-04:00 UTC), we need to run a focused priming exercise that covers certificate rotation, SAN (Subject Alternative Name) validation across the VPC front-door, and a short post-cutover smoke sweep. This thread will be the single source for the plan, owners, and artifacts.

High level plan (two phases):
- Phase A (pre-cutover, today/Tomorrow): rotate the X.509 leaf certs for internal API gateways + validate SAN entries for all VIPs; warm K/V caches; verify TLS handshake matrix. Expected duration: 90m.
- Phase B (cutover window): execute network switch, apply final cert TTL bump, run smoke checklist and SAN probe across eu/us edge (internal probes only). Expected duration: 120m.

Immediate asks:
1) Ellis / ACME Ops — confirm the final external VIP names you will route (we expect: api.acme-prod, private.api.acme) and whether any wildcard SANs are still required.
2) VaultCorp / support — confirm KMS key rollover TTL and whether we should stagger key versions across pools to avoid simultaneous rewraps.
3) Rishi / Aditya — please confirm tooling: will we run the SAN probes from the proto-probes host (10.40.2.5) and the ops-runbook in Drive?

Attachments: cert_rotation_plan.pdf (detailed steps, rollback), priming-runbook-v2.md (runbook link inside).

Acceptance criteria for GO: all certs rotated without TLS handshake failures seen in <= 5% of sampled connections; SAN validation passes for every VIP in the inventory; no cert-related 5xxs for 15 minutes post-swap.

I'm standing by on the bridge at 01:30 UTC for signoff.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
mobile: +1-415-555-0198

From: Ellis Trujillo <ellis.trujillo@acmecloud.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Cloud Ops <ops@acmecloud.com>, DataCenter NOC <noc@dc.example.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Certificate rotation & SAN validation — pre-cutover priming and post-cutover smoke plan

Thanks Mina — quick clarifications:

- VIP list: confirming api.acme-prod, private.api.acme, and analytics.acme (NOTE: analytics currently uses a wildcard SAN for legacy clients). We will try to remove the wildcard but may need it for 24 hours post-cutover.
- KMS: we need a short maintenance window for key rewraps; can that be staggered?
- Probing: we can host an external probe instance if you need outside-of-VPC validation; however, primary validation will be from your proto-probes host as you outlined.

We expect to have one ops engineer (Ellis) and two network NOC folks on the bridge. Send me the RFC/ACL updates and I'll pre-stage them with our edge gateways.

-Ellis
Ellis Trujillo
Platform Ops, AcmeCloud
ellis.trujillo@acmecloud.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellis Trujillo <ellis.trujillo@acmecloud.com>, ACME Cloud Ops <ops@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Certificate rotation & SAN validation — pre-cutover priming and post-cutover smoke plan

Folks — attaching the condensed owner checklist from the runbook and the cert rotation playbook (cert_rotation_plan.pdf). Key items (owners):

1) Inventory freeze (Aditya) — final VIP list in INF-4721; lock by 18:00 UTC today.
2) Cert rollout (Aditya / Rishi) — rotate leaf certs in staggered batches (batch size = 20 hosts) with 3m steady-state between batches.
3) SAN probe (Rishi) — run point-in-time SAN probe from 10.40.2.5 and external probe hosted by Ellis. Probe script: run san_probe.sh --targets inventory_vips.csv --report san_validation_results.csv.
4) KMS/key-wrap (VaultCorp contact) — stagger rewrap by pool: pool-a @ +00m, pool-b @ +15m. Confirmed fallback: keep previous key version alive for 2 hours.
5) Rollback trigger (Laura) — if cert-related 5xxs exceed 5% or auth errors spike for 10m, rollback to previous cert bundle per section 7.

Runbook link: https://docs.redwood.com/private-deploy/runbooks/priming-v2
Jira: INF-4721 (inventory + gating)

Attachments: cert_rotation_plan.pdf

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Network Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellis Trujillo <ellis.trujillo@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Certificate rotation & SAN validation — pre-cutover priming and post-cutover smoke plan

LGTM from an ops readiness standpoint. A few notes:
- I reviewed the smoke checklist and tightened the ordering so we run health endpoint checks before perf probes (to avoid false positives from warm caches).
- I'll be owner of the rollback decision if errors cross thresholds.
- I'll also own the post-cutover 15-minute observation window and will run an abbreviated set of load-lite checks at +5/+10/+15.

I've attached the postcutover-smoke-checklist.xlsx export with the exact probe commands.

Once Ellis confirms the wildcard requirement for analytics.acme, we can finalize the RFC and lock inventory by 18:00 UTC.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Product Reliability, Redwood Inference

From: VaultCorp Support <support@vaultcorp.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Certificate rotation & SAN validation — pre-cutover priming and post-cutover smoke plan

Hi Mina / team,

Confirmed: we can stagger the KMS rewraps by pool. Recommendations:
- Stagger by 15 minutes between pools to avoid a mass rewrap event.
- Keep prior key version active for 2 hours after rewrap (as you propose).
- We will set rewrap TTL to 7 days for these certificates for safety and increase alerting on rewrap failures to Sev-2 during the window.

Please send us the final pool list and a contact phone number for on-call escalation during the 02:00-04:00 UTC window.

Regards,
VaultCorp Support
support@vaultcorp.io

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellis Trujillo <ellis.trujillo@acmecloud.com>, ACME Cloud Ops <ops@acmecloud.com>, VaultCorp Support <support@vaultcorp.io>, DataCenter NOC <noc@dc.example.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Certificate rotation & SAN validation — pre-cutover priming and post-cutover smoke plan — POST-EXECUTION SUMMARY

Team — quick summary from the run:

- Window: 2026-10-02 02:00-04:00 UTC (cutover executed on schedule).
- Cert rotation: completed, staggered by pool per plan. No mass rewrap spike observed.
- SAN validation: all VIPs passed the probe from internal host and external probe (analytics.acme kept wildcard for 24h). Attached: san_validation_results.csv (probe output).
- Smoke: abbreviated checks at +5/+10/+15 passed; TLS handshake failure rate observed = 0.7% (under threshold). No cert-related 5xxs detected after the rollback window.
- Issues: one legacy client (internal ID: legacy-312) presented an older TLS client that did not send SNI; we rolled a temporary fallback ALB rule and logged the client for follow-up.

Next steps:
- Aditya to remove temporary ALB fallback rule and escalate legacy-312 ticket.
- Laura to close out the observation ticket if no regressions within 24h.
- VaultCorp to confirm key version deprecation schedule (follow-up by tomorrow EOD).

Thanks everyone for quick responses and precise execution. Bridge is clear from my side.

Attachments: san_validation_results.csv, postcutover-smoke-checklist.xlsx

Mina
Mina Haddad
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
